global_caveats: These are conceptual 'opinion of probable cost' figures for sample barriers at sample sites in the City of Boston guidelines published October 2018. They are not bids, not 2026 prices, and not transferable per-foot rates for another site.
Escalation from the 2018 publication date to today is not applied here. Any escalation index and base year must be chosen by a cost estimator.
The guidelines state each opinion reflects sample design considerations and does not reflect engineering analyses prepared for design.

estimating_method_guidance: Treat the sample $/100-LF as an order-of-magnitude reference only; site length, grade change, setbacks, utilities and foundations drive the real number.

A preliminary estimate for this corridor would start from surveyed length and required grade change, quantity take-offs per line item, current local unit prices, escalation from the price base year, and explicitly priced exclusions (pumps, utilities, permitting).
Present any scaled number as 'illustrative scaling of a 2018 sample', never as a project cost.
